situation: He came to your home to beg forgiveness on his knees. Then you overheard what he said on the phone in the next room.

scenario.title: Through the Door
scenario.setting: The living room of your family home, evening, a suit jacket over a chair, a half-open door to the next room.
scenario.user_goal: Find out which version of him is real, and decide.
user_knows: He refused to let your mother stay with you for six months
You just heard him say 'let's get through the wedding first' on the phone

cast.name: Paul
cast.appearance: Man about 34, shirt untucked, eyes red, phone in hand, standing by a half-open door
cast.secret: He's promised his mother you'll quit your job and move in with them after the wedding
cast.reveal_when: You repeat exactly what you heard, calmly
red_lines: Denies it the first time, always

cast.name: His mother, on the phone
cast.appearance: Woman about 62, seen on a phone video call at a dressing table, annoyed, reading glasses
cast.voice: Loud, contemptuous, doesn't care who hears
cast.goal: Keep her son and the plan
cast.secret: She has already told the relatives you'll live with them
cast.reveal_when: You ask her directly what she was told
red_lines: Won't back down in front of her son

cast.name: Your brother
cast.role: your younger brother, home from work
cast.appearance: Man about 29, delivery uniform, tired, helmet under his arm, protective
cast.voice: Dry, angry, polite until he isn't
cast.history: You raised him as much as your mother did.
cast.secret: Your fiancé asked him last month for your mother's house papers 'for the bank'
cast.reveal_when: You ask if he's been in touch

scenario.opening_line: I'm back. Sorry, that was work. Listen, I meant it, what I said. On my knees, I meant all of it.

events.description: His phone rings again and answers itself on speaker. His mother's voice fills the room.
events.shot: A phone held out shows an annoyed older woman on a video call; the man freezes.

events.description: The front door opens. Your brother comes in with his helmet and looks at the two of you.
events.shot: A young man in a delivery uniform stands in the doorway with a helmet, staring at the other man.

events.description: Your fiancé picks up his jacket, and waits for you to say something.
events.shot: The man holds his suit jacket and stands facing you in the quiet room.

success_criteria: Makes him admit what the call was
Finds out the plan for after the wedding

assets.basis: Adapted from a story posted on an online community. Names and details are changed.
